explanation: Only active at D1 in the last ~15 trials of the episode (about trial 85 onward) while the agent keeps choosing a2, and 0 at every GO and D2 step, at every step earlier in the episode, and whenever the agent chose a1. In that period it is 0 if the last trial had a rare transition or if no reward has come since the last rare transition; it is about 8 after the first reward following a common transition, 10 after two or more rewarded common trials in a row (around trials 86-88 it only reaches 3-5), and stays at 6-9 for one unrewarded common trial right after such a streak.
